<description>
During rbitcoin's development, we created some additional script test vectors, some of which seem like they would be valuable additions to bitcoin core's script tests.

These cover mostly script limits on various versions, but also the non-FindAndDelete behavior of witness v0.
</description>

<commits>
ba7d259670 test: assert v0 and tapscript size limits

Add script tests for witness v0 size limits and the lack of those same
limits in tapscript.

efb5d657bc test: assert OP_SUCCESS before script limits

Add script tests that verify OP_SUCCESS handling before script limits
are applied.

320ea87bf9 test: assert witness v0 scripts skip FindAndDelete

Add script tests validating the lack of FindAndDelete behavior when
executing witness v0 scripts.

43e35d6a50 test: assert tapscript signature weight budget

Add script tests for tapscript signature weight, including for
non-empty, non-32-byte keys, and empty and non-empty signatures.

60bb41f494 test: assert unknown tapleaf versions skip limits

Add script tests that validate unknown tapleaves are not subject to
tapleaf 0xc2 witness limits.
</commits>
